main_text.p: Fructuum qualita-tes Secun-da.Hactenus fuerunt Fructus alteran-tes qualitate prima; Sequuntur,quæ alterant qualitate Secunda.
Illi aut astringunt; ut baccæ Myrti, Berberis, Castanea, Cornus, Cotonea, Galla, Glans, Mespila, Mala punica, nux Moschata, Olivæ, Omphacium, Palmulæ, Pyra, Persica, &c.
Aut extenuant; ut Amygdalæ dulces, baccæ Juniperi, &c.
Aut Flatus discutiunt: ut baccæ Lauri, Juniperi, nux Moschata, Piper, &c.
Aut Semen generant: Ficus, nux Pinea, nux Indica, &c.
Aut Menses movent: baccæ Hederæ, Cappares, Nuclei Persicorum, Piper.
Aut Menses sistunt: Berberis, Uva passa cum Nucleis.
Aut Venenis resistunt: baccæ Juniperi, Juglans, mala Citria, Piper.

page.notes: The faint word at the lower left of the text block (possibly "Hactę-") is too blurred to read with confidence and is not transcribed. The catchword "Aut" is taken from the lower right. The printed text uses "Fructus" and "Persicorum" as shown. Hyphenation in the margin note is as printed.
